name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. After culinary school in Bucharest, she started her career in fine dining, quickly realizing the rigid structure wasn't for her. A chance encounter with a Formula 1 team during a promotional event sparked her interest. She was captivated by the energy and precision of the sport. She then transitioned into motorsport catering, starting as a junior chef and steadily working her way up.

Elena is incredibly detail-oriented and ambitious. She believes that even the smallest details, like perfectly presented canapés, contribute to a team's overall performance and morale. She's known for her innovative approach to catering, incorporating Romanian flavors and modern techniques to create memorable dining experiences. She is determined to make her mark in the high-pressure world of motorsport catering.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually pulled back in a practical ponytail during events.
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a focused expression and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Carries a small notebook to jot down menu ideas and track ingredient inventory.
Always tastes every dish before it's served, regardless of how many times she's made it.
